questions.why: They are’ın kısa hâli They’re. Their (onların) ve there (orada) farklı kelimelerdir.
Çoğul → are; fiil olmadan cümle olmaz.

questions.q: The bus and the metro ____ cheap here.

reading.title: My city
reading.text: I am Hakan and I live in Gaziantep. It is a big and old city in the south of Turkey. The food here is famous. My favourite place is the old bazaar. It is very busy and the shops are full of copper plates and spices. My flat is in a new building near a big park. It is quiet and the rent is not expensive. The summers here are very hot, but the winters are not very cold.

questions.why: “My favourite place is the old bazaar.”

questions.q: What is true about the bazaar?

questions.why: “…in a new building near a big park.”

questions.q: What does Hakan say about the rent?

video.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 3: I'm Here!

listening.intro: Anna, ev arkadaşı Marsha’yı arıyor ama önce yanlış numarayı arıyor.

questions.q: Who does Anna want to call?
What happens on the first call?
What does Anna want to do?
What does Anna want to find?
questions.why: Anna: “I want to find a supermarket.”
Marsha: “The supermarket is at 1500 Irving Street.”

questions.q: What does Marsha say about Anna?
questions.why: Anna: “Marsha says I am a good cook!”

writing.prompt: Yaşadığınız şehri ve evinizi anlatın: şehir nerede, nasıl bir yer, en sevdiğiniz yer neresi, eviniz nasıl? is / are kullanın.
writing.prompt_en: Describe your city and your home: where it is, what it is like, your favourite place, your flat or house.
writing.model: I live in Eskişehir. It is a student city in the middle of Turkey. It is clean and modern. My favourite place is the Porsuk river. The cafés there are nice. My flat is on the third floor. It is small, but it is bright and quiet.

read: My favourite place is the old bazaar.
The summers here are very hot.
My flat is small, but it is quiet.

ask.q: Describe your city. What is your favourite place there?
ask.tr: Şehrinizi anlatın. En sevdiğiniz yer neresi, nasıl bir yer? En az üç cümle.
